gloss: to be half-asleep; to be groggy

definitions.gloss: to be half-asleep; to be groggy
definitions.explanation: To be in a drowsy state between sleeping and waking, often acting confused.

definitions.gloss: to talk nonsense; to be out of it
definitions.explanation: To say or do things that don't make sense, as if still dreaming.

examples.japanese: {寝惚|ねぼ}けていて{時計|とけい}を{見間違|みまちが}えた。
examples.english: I was half-asleep and misread the clock.

examples.japanese: {寝惚|ねぼ}けたことを{言|い}うな。
{朝|あさ}は{寝惚|ねぼ}けてしまう。
examples.english: I tend to be groggy in the morning.

examples.japanese: {寝惚|ねぼ}けた{顔|かお}で{学校|がっこう}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: He came to school with a groggy face.

examples.japanese: そんな{値段|ねだん}で{売|う}れるわけないだろう。{寝惚|ねぼ}けたことを{言|い}うな。
examples.english: There's no way it would sell at that price. Don't be ridiculous.

examples.japanese: {寝惚|ねぼ}けて{靴下|くつした}を{左右|さゆう}{違|ちが}うのを{履|は}いてしまった。
examples.english: I was so groggy that I put on mismatched socks.

notes:
{寝惚|ねぼ}ける is an ichidan verb from {寝|ね} (sleep) + {惚|ぼ}ける (to be dazed).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝惚|ねぼ}けた{顔|かお} (ねぼけたかお): groggy face, sleepy-looking face
- {寝惚|ねぼ}けたことを{言|い}う: to say ridiculous things (implying the person isn't thinking clearly)

RELATED WORDS:
- {寝|ね}ぼすけ: sleepyhead
- {寝起|ねお}き (ねおき): just woken up
